policy_title: Ensure Post Office Horizon Scandal Redress
stated: The Conservative Party will ensure the new redress scheme for victims of the Post Office Horizon scandal is in place and ready to make payments to claimants by the end of July.

source.quote: We have taken exceptional and unprecedented action, legislating to quash the convictions of those affected by the Post Office Horizon scandal... We will ensure the new redress scheme is in place and ready to make payments to claimants by the end of July.

bearing_set.reason: The Horizon scandal involved wrongful prosecutions and convictions based on flawed evidence — redress directly addresses due process failures, miscarriages of justice, and legal rights of victims.

The Horizon redress scheme carries an estimated fiscal cost of £1 billion or more in compensation payments, constituting a non-negligible call on public finances that bears on debt-path sustainability.

membership_note: The policy's primary bearing is restorative justice (O9); the fiscal cost of the redress scheme is large enough to earn a real verdict on public finances (O12). Individual financial losses to victims do not independently register as O4 or O11 here — they are incidental consequences of the miscarriage of justice, not labour-market or tax-policy effects.
